title: About Snapped Up
description: Who we are and how we pick the deals on Snapped Up.
body:
Snapped Up exists because most "deals" aren't. Prices get nudged up before a sale so the discount looks bigger, and "was" prices are often ones nobody ever paid.

So we keep it simple. Every day we look through the UK's big retailers and pick only the offers that are genuinely good value.

## How we pick

- **We check the history.** A deal only makes the cut if the price is at or near the lowest it has been recently, not just lower than an inflated "was" price.
- **We say when to wait.** If something is likely to be cheaper in a bigger sale, we'll tell you.
- **We keep it short.** A handful of good picks beats fifty mediocre ones.

## Weekly spotlights

Each week we pick one category that's worth shopping right now, because of the season, a big sale or a new product launch, and write a proper guide to it.

## Get in touch

Spotted a price that's changed, or a deal we should know about? Email us at [hello@snappedupdeals.co.uk](mailto:hello@snappedupdeals.co.uk).
